purpose: Calculate Solvency II SCR and MCR coverage ratios from eligible own funds and capital requirements. Checks the own-funds SCR tiering limits per Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/35 Art. 82(1): Tier 1 at least 50% of SCR, Tier 3 less than 15% of SCR, Tier 2 plus Tier 3 at most 50% of SCR, and restricted Tier 1 less than 20% of total Tier 1 (Art. 82(3)). An omitted tier2 is treated as 0, which makes the Tier 2 plus Tier 3 test lenient. The 80% Tier 1 floor is the MCR rule (Art. 82(2)) and is not applied to the SCR; MCR tiering limits and the transitional Tier 1 items are not modelled. Returns scr_coverage_ratio, mcr_coverage_ratio, scr_breached, mcr_breached, tiering_ok, and per-tier percentages. Sec. 16 proof candidate. Root node of the solvency-ii-reconciliation-and-capital chain. Solvency II Dir. 2009/138/EC + Del. Reg. 2015/35. NaN-safe. Zero network, zero PII.
